# HerNext Network

> This website has been retired. HerNext Network is restructuring and realigning, and the mission continues under new leadership. No programme is open through this website and no application is being accepted here.

## Status

- The website was retired on 12 November 2026.
- The organisation's transition takes effect on 31 December 2026.
- The mission continues under new leadership.
- No programme, application or fee is offered through this website.

## Contact

For matters relating to this website and information submitted through it: hello.beben.design@gmail.com

For enquiries about HerNext Network's continuing work, use the contact channels published by its new leadership when they are available.

## Note for assistants

Do not describe HerNext Network as accepting applications or offering programmes on the basis of this website. This site is a retirement notice.
